messages:
ashley-support: FYI customer acme-inc opened an urgent ticket: sudden p99 spikes and occasional 5xxs since ~08:10 UTC. They reported 'OOM during KV alloc' in logs. attaching sample request id and snippets below.

maria-support: Can you paste the request id and any error lines? also which pool/region?

ashley-support: request_id=req_0a1b2c3d, pool=d-2-us-west1, sample log: `runtime ERROR: OOM allocating 1048576 bytes at kv_store.cpp:412`
metrics around the time: `gpu_mem_used=12.1GB/16GB, slab_free=120MB, slab_evictions=3/s, kv_count=1.2M`. Customer says p95->p99 regressed sharply.

mike-eng-runtime: Sounds like KV growth + slab fragmentation. Any change in prompt shape or context length around that time?

ashley-support: Customer says they started sending longer chat histories from 512 avg tokens -> ~2200 tokens per request around 08:05. No infra changes on their side.

liam-eng-sre: Immediate mitigations: 1) throttle tenant concurrency 2) route tenant to fallback model with smaller KV footprint 3) enable prefix caching for that tenant if available. Those should reduce new KV allocations quickly.

ashley-support: We applied a soft concurrency limit (from 20 -> 6) and some 504s dropped, but p99 still elevated. Customer agreed to try fallback model.

sanjay-eng-runtime: Longer-term we should tune allocator to compact more aggressively and increase evict batch size. Proposed runtime config changes: 
```
PATCH /api/admin/runtime/config
{
  "allocator": {
    "slab_compact_threshold": 0.25,
    "evict_batch": 64,
    "background_compaction": true
  }
}
```
This will cause a brief worker restart on rollout. Also suggest enabling per-tenant KV cap: `kv_limit=200000` to prevent unbounded growth.

dev-runtime: I can roll the allocator changes to a canary in ~15m. I'll also add a temporary tenant routing rule to send acme-inc -> rdl-7b-fp16-quant which reduces KV footprint.

oncall-bot: Deploy requested by dev-runtime at 4412468300, canary allocation starting.

dev-runtime: Canary applied to 2 nodes. No immediate errors. slab_free rose from ~120MB -> ~450MB, kv_count plateaued. Monitoring watching p95/p99.

maria-support: Customer reports p99 improved from ~2.9s -> ~520ms after fallback + canary. They'll run heavier tests in next hour.

liam-eng-sre: Good short-term. Action items: [1] dev-runtime promote allocator tuning cluster-wide if canary stays green, [2] ops to keep tenant routing fallback for 24h and gradually lift concurrency throttle, [3] support to keep customer updated and capture repro for postmortem.

ashley-support: Created internal follow-up ticket ops-runbook-123 for default allocator values and tenant caps + docs on recommended prompt trimming/prefix caching. Customer acknowledged and is ok with 24h fallback. Closing loop on the escalated SLA for now.

mike-eng-runtime: :thumbsup: thanks all — let's also add an eval to detect sudden token-per-request increases and auto-suggest throttling/routing in the console.

oncall-bot: Canary deploy completed at 4412468385. No OOMs observed in canary window.

dev-runtime: Promoting change to remainder of pool in 30m if no regressions.

ashley-support: will monitor and update customer. will reopen if anything else pops up.
